title: Norm Blanchard W.O.O.D. Regatta: September 20th, 2025

# Norm Blanchard W.O.O.D. Regatta: September 20th, 2025

## About the Race:
The Center for Wooden Boats' annual regatta honors Norman C. Blanchard, a Pacific Northwest wooden boatbuilder. It is a day-long regatta followed by a BBQ (tickets sold separately). Registration is not yet open — it opens September 10, for racers aged 12 and up.

## Who Can Participate?
- **Youth (ages 12-18):** Parents must complete the Youth waiver form; sailors must have completed Youth Sailing 2 or equivalent.
- **Adults (18+):** Must have a Blue Livery Card. Schedule check-outs via [adultsailing@cwb.org](mailto:adultsailing@cwb.org).
- **CWB boats** are assigned first-come, first-assigned on race day:
  - Large fleet (2-4 crew): Thunderbird Kittiwake, Blanchard Junior Knockabouts, Kitten Lucille, Great Pelican
  - Small fleet (1-2 crew): El Toros, Pelican, Catboat Riff, Port Madison Pram Mary I, Ed Monk Sloop L'Hirondelle, Sailing Peapods, Navron, Barbara Anne
- **Bring your own boat:** open to wooden boats of all sizes and non-wood versions of traditional one-designs. Include your boat's rating when registering, if you have one.

Separate prizes are awarded for each class (three or more boats of the same type). Unrated boats can't compete for ranking but may win category awards.

## Tentative Race Day Schedule: Saturday, September 20, 2025
- 9:00-10:00 — Registration
- 10:00-11:00 — Skippers meeting
- 11:00-12:00 — Rigging and practice
- 12:00-2:00 — First races (two races)
- 2:00-3:00 — Break
- 3:00-5:00 — Final races
- 4:30-7:00 — BBQ and awards

## After Race BBQ
BBQ tickets are sold separately; the BBQ starts around 4:30 or 5:00 after the last race. Family and friends are welcome at the dock.

Questions: [adultsailing@cwb.org](mailto:adultsailing@cwb.org)
